A portable cabin in Faridabad is a factory-built steel-and-panel unit used as a site office, security cabin, store room or worker facility on industrial and construction sites. SAMAN Portable manufactures these cabins and dispatches them ready-to-use to Faridabad, Ballabhgarh, Surajkund and Sector 21, so your team gets a usable workspace in days instead of weeks.

Serving India since 2009 (incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019), we build to a consistent standard and supply Delhi-NCR direct from our Greater Noida factory. This page explains what a portable cabin costs to specify, the sizes and build, and how delivery to Faridabad works.

What decides the price of a portable cabin in Faridabad?

The price of a portable cabin in Faridabad depends on its size, panel thickness, insulation, and internal fit-out — not on a single fixed rate. A bare 10ft x 8ft site office costs far less than a 40ft fitted office with toilet, partitions and wiring. Tell us the use and size and we send a written quote.

Main cost factors:

  • Footprint and height — 10ft, 20ft or 40ft length; standard 8ft height.
  • Panel type and thickness — roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels for thermal comfort; thicker panels cost more.
  • Fit-out — flooring grade, partitions, attached toilet, windows and door type.
  • Electricals — basic lighting and points versus a full distribution board.
  • Delivery distance — default delivery is ₹3,000; final freight depends on the site location and access.

Because we are the manufacturer, you pay for the build, not a reseller margin. Send your requirement for a quote rather than working from a generic per-square-foot figure.

Types of portable cabins for Faridabad sites

Each unit below is built on the same steel frame and customised to your layout. They are all portable cabins — a cabin used as an office is a cabin office, not a separate product.

PUF panel site offices

Insulated site offices with PUF sandwich panels for thermal comfort. Suited to project managers and supervisors at construction sites across Sector 21 and Ballabhgarh.

  • Roughly 50 mm insulated panels
  • Provision for lighting and power points
  • Customisable internal layout
  • Weather-resistant exterior skin

Security cabins

Compact, durable cabins for entry gates and perimeter posts. Common at industrial plots in Surajkund and Sector 31 for gate control.

  • Window placement for clear sightlines
  • Steel door with lock
  • Optional electrical fittings
  • Weather-resistant build

Toilet blocks

Toilet units for construction sites and temporary workplaces. Useful for worker welfare on larger jobs in Ballabhgarh and Sector 16.

  • Single and multi-unit configurations
  • Water tank and waste provision
  • Easy-clean interiors
  • Ventilation and lighting

Storage cabins

Weather-proof storage for tools, materials and inventory. Used at manufacturing plots across Faridabad's industrial sectors.

  • Sturdy frame for heavy-duty use
  • Lockable for valuable equipment
  • Optional shelving
  • Weather-resistant skin

Modular cabin offices

Expandable cabin offices for growing teams. Suited to Ballabhgarh's developing industrial zones where layouts change over time.

  • Modular sections that combine
  • Clean interior finishes
  • Provision for electrical and networking
  • AC-ready

Worker accommodation

On-site living units for workers. Useful for larger projects in Sector 31 where local housing is limited.

  • Bunk configurations
  • Basic washing facility provision
  • Ventilation and insulation
  • Built to labour-welfare needs

Build quality and technical specifications

Every SAMAN portable cabin is built on a mild-steel frame conforming to IS 2062, clad with insulated PUF sandwich panels and finished for Indian site conditions. The table below shows standard build and the upgrades you can specify.

Specification Standard build Upgrade option
Frame MS frame to IS 2062, powder-coated Heavier section for high-load use
Wall panels ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ min density) Thicker panels for higher insulation
Roof GI roofing sheet with insulation Double-layer insulated roof
Skin Pre-galvanised steel skin Coated finish for coastal/dusty sites
Doors and windows Steel door with lock; sliding windows with grill Security door; double-glazed windows
Electrical Lighting and power points Full package with distribution board

Standard sizes

Cabin type Approx. size (L×W×H) Best for
Compact 10ft × 8ft × 8ft Small site offices, security cabins
Standard office 20ft × 10ft × 8ft Project offices, small teams
Large office 40ft × 10ft × 8ft Admin offices, meeting space
Toilet block 10ft × 8ft × 8ft 2-4 toilet units
Storage 20ft × 8ft × 8ft Equipment and material storage

Custom sizes available. We manufacture portable cabins to your exact specification for any project in Faridabad, Ballabhgarh, Surajkund and surrounding areas. Browse the full portable cabin range to see configurations.

Delivery and installation across Faridabad

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, which keeps Faridabad within easy same-region reach. Standard cabins typically reach site in 3-5 days; fitted or custom units take longer to build. Default delivery is ₹3,000, with final freight depending on your exact location and site access.

Areas we serve in Faridabad

  • Ballabhgarh industrial area
  • Surajkund and surrounding region
  • Sector 21 commercial zone
  • Sector 16 industrial hub
  • Sector 31 development area
  • Industrial corridors and construction sites across Faridabad

What to expect

  • Standard cabins: about 3-5 days
  • Custom or fitted units: longer build time, confirmed on quote
  • Installation handled by our team
  • Site-prep advice before delivery
  • A level base (concrete pad or compacted ground) is needed

Note for Delhi-NCR sites: during GRAP construction-ban windows (typically October to February) wet construction can be restricted, while dry-assembly factory-built cabins are generally not barred — a practical reason many Faridabad sites choose portable cabins.

Why buy factory-direct from SAMAN

SAMAN Portable is a manufacturer, not a reseller, so you deal with the people who build the cabin. We have delivered 500+ projects across India and run an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1-2 years finishing + 20-25 years engineered service life. (The 20-25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Returns: 7-day return window after delivery; return transport is at the customer's cost.
  • Standards: MS frame to IS 2062; insulated PUF panels for Faridabad's summer heat and winter cold.
  • Direct quoting: a written quote based on your real size and fit-out, not a guessed rate.

This is an enquiry-only business — there is no online checkout. You confirm your build and price with our team, then we manufacture and dispatch.

Frequently asked questions about portable cabins in Faridabad


How quickly can you deliver a portable cabin in Faridabad?

Standard cabin configurations typically reach site in 3-5 days across Faridabad, Ballabhgarh and Surajkund, dispatched from our Greater Noida factory. Custom or fitted units take longer to build; we confirm the timeline on your quote.


What decides the price of a portable cabin?

Size, panel thickness, insulation, internal fit-out (flooring, partitions, attached toilet, electricals) and delivery distance set the price. There is no single fixed rate — share your requirement and we send a written quote.


What site preparation is needed before installation?

You need a level base — usually a concrete pad or well-compacted ground with drainage. For short-term use, an adjustable foundation can work. Our team gives site-prep guidance before delivery so installation is straightforward.


Are portable cabins suitable during Delhi-NCR construction bans?

Generally yes. During GRAP restriction windows, wet construction may be limited, but dry-assembly factory-built cabins are usually not barred because they are installed, not cast on site. Confirm current rules with local authorities for your project.


What warranty do you offer?

Our cabins carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1-2 years finishing + 20-25 years engineered service life. The 20-25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Can a portable cabin be relocated later?

Yes. A key advantage is mobility — the cabin can be lifted and moved as your project changes. Our team can handle disassembly, transport and reinstallation so the unit stays in good condition after a move.

Get a quote for a portable cabin in Faridabad

Tell us the cabin type, size and where it is going in Faridabad, and we will send a written quote with build and delivery details. For a faster start, view the portable cabin range or ask about a cabin office configuration.

Need a portable cabin for your Faridabad project?

Speak to the manufacturer for the right cabin and a clear quote.

Call +91 62009 09435

WhatsApp: +91 62009 09435 · or use Send Enquiry on this page.
